subject: Quantitative Aptitude
topic: Boats and streams II — mixed tiers
description: Upstream/downstream, still-water speed, current speed, round-trip times

questions.stem: A boat travels at 10 km/h in still water. The speed of the stream is 2 km/h. Speed downstream is:
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = boat speed + stream speed = 10 + 2 = 12 km/h. Upstream = 10 − 2 = 8 km/h. Distractor 8 = upstream. Distractor 10 = still-water. Distractor 14 = wrong sum.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.topic: Boats and streams II — mixed tiers

questions.stem: If a man rows 18 km downstream in 3 hr and 18 km upstream in 6 hr, the speed of the stream is:
questions.explanation: Down speed = 18/3 = 6 km/h. Up speed = 18/6 = 3 km/h. Stream = (down − up)/2 = (6−3)/2 = 1.5 km/h. Boat in still water = (down + up)/2 = 4.5 km/h. Distractors are common miscomputations.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.topic: Boats and streams II — mixed tiers

questions.stem: A boat goes 36 km downstream in 6 hr and 24 km upstream in 6 hr. Speed of boat in still water is:
questions.explanation: Down speed = 36/6 = 6 km/h. Up speed = 24/6 = 4 km/h. Boat in still water = (6+4)/2 = 5 km/h. Stream speed = (6−4)/2 = 1 km/h. Distractor 4 = upstream speed. Distractor 6 = downstream speed. Distractor 3 from another miscomputation.

questions.stem: If a swimmer's downstream speed is twice his upstream speed, the ratio of his speed in still water to stream's speed is:
questions.explanation: Let boat = b, stream = s. Down = b+s; Up = b−s. Given down = 2 × up → b+s = 2(b−s) → b+s = 2b−2s → 3s = b → b/s = 3/1. So ratio 3:1. Distractor 2:1 = down:up. Distractors 4:1, 5:2 from other miscomputations.

questions.topic: Boats and streams II — mixed tiers

questions.stem: A boat covers 24 km upstream in 6 hr and 36 km downstream in the same 6 hr. Boat's still-water speed is:
questions.explanation: Up = 24/6 = 4 km/h. Down = 36/6 = 6 km/h. Boat = (4+6)/2 = 5 km/h. Stream = (6−4)/2 = 1 km/h. Distractor 4 = upstream. Distractor 6 = downstream. Distractor 3 unrelated.
